verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents scheduling, whether a one-off timed task or a recurring schedule, that runs automatically and returns results. Cowork's multi-step tasks and the generic "automate repetitive tasks" marketing line describe on-demand or vague automation, not scheduled execution. Proactive research suggestions are a different feature, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results
